family: The single total uniform family defined in proof.md: for input length N, let B be the least positive integer with B^5 > 32 N^3 and k the least prime >= B; if k >= N, output 0. Otherwise read the first k input bits as the lower coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2 and output 0 unless Q passes the exact irreducibility test of proof.md Section 2. Split the remaining m = N - k bits into r = ceil(m/k) blocks over K = F_2[Z]/(Q) (zero padding, first bit the constant coefficient), put y_i = a_i^(2^(i+1)-1), and output the constant coefficient of Sym_r^t(y_1,...,y_r), t = ceil(sqrt(r)), computed by the division-free recurrence of proof.md. One fixed polynomial-time evaluator computes every length.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, for every integer N >= 2^20, C_B2(f_N) >= 4N - 31*N^(4/5) in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length N; in particular liminf over all integer N of C_B2(f_N)/N >= 4.
